home.seoTitle: Escape From Duckov Fan Wiki — Raid Loadout + Hideout Planner
home.seoDescription: Unofficial Escape From Duckov wiki: Raid Loadout + Hideout Planner, beginner guide, Steam trailers & screenshots. Plan raids and hideout goals — not a damage cheat sheet.
home.h1: Escape From Duckov raid loadout & fan wiki
home.pitch: Scavenge, extract, build your hideout. Plan raid loadouts and hideout upgrade goals, share the URL, then read a Steam-grounded beginner guide.
home.pitch2: Steam-first facts for Escape From Duckov (Team Soda / bilibili, app 3167020). No invented DPS tables — this wiki is a planner log and thin guide layer, not a damage-number cheat sheet.
home.scan1: Primary tool: Raid Loadout + Hideout Planner — map + gear slots + hideout focus → shareable URL.
home.scan2: Steam loop: scavenge → extract → sell/upgrade hideout & gear → quests → stronger runs.
home.scan3: Start as an Average Duck with ordinary stats and one basic gun (Steam about text).
home.scan4: Five unique maps; official map/weapon names & DPS: Unknown on the Steam store — we label Unknown.
home.scan5: Not a damage cheat sheet: no forged DPS grids, drop rates, or invented skill-tree math.
home.scan6: Steam Workshop + 55 achievements listed — log your own loadouts; don’t invent Workshop stats.
home.cardLoadoutBody: Presets, Unknown-safe slots, raid checklist, Copy link + Copy log. Planner UX — not a DPS table.
home.cardBeginnerBody: First raid, extract habits, hideout loop, system requirements — Steam facts only.
home.cardFaqBody: Platforms, why no DPS sheets, how URL sharing works, Workshop, Steam snapshot answers.
home.cardAboutBody: Unofficial EN scope, Steam-only sourcing, Unknown labels for unpublished data.

home.features: Steam framing: scavenge & extract across five maps; build hideout; 50+ weapons with mods; blueprints & skill trees; quests/NPCs; Steam Workshop. Categories include Single-player, Steam Achievements (55), Trading Cards, Workshop, Steam Cloud, Family Sharing.
